_comment: The licence notice a backup file carries in its `_comment` array, line by line.
Loaded by BOTH suites: GplNoticeTest.kt holds Android's GplNotice.HEADER_LINES
to it, GplNoticeVectorTest.swift the kit's GplNotice.headerLines (which
BackupWriter embeds). Until the v0.86.0 review iOS wrote a four-line summary
where Android wrote the full notice, so two exports of the same diary differed
in their first lines. Both importers ignore the field; this pins the text so
